The '''''Mother Grace''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ship used by [[Grace Command]].

==History==
The ''Mother Grace'' was a sleek relief vessel operating out of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that worked in conjunction with [[Devil Squadron]]. The unit of [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter|''Fire Lotus''-class starfighters]] destroyed opposing forces prior to ''Mother Grace''{{'s}} arrival, in order to secure the delivery of food and medicine to stricken areas.
